infographic.title: From H2S Release to Alarm
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four stages from an H2S release to a detector alarm and response
steps: H2S escapes from a process, well or drain.
Heavier than air, it collects in low lying areas.
A sensor mounted low measures the ppm level.
Set points trigger alarms so people can respond.
